title: KCP protocol_info request (DESIGN.md §11.1, §11.6.1 pre-auth family; derived — gap note KG2)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Pre-auth negotiation operation: the closed shape carries no realm_id, project_id, identity, or credential member (§11.1; gap note KG1). Public protocol/installation metadata read for one-shot bindings that never handshake (§11.1). Registry (core_v1): surface external_client / pre-auth channel (assurance: none). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: No arguments: §11.6.1 grants this pre-auth operation bounded public installation metadata only; the closed empty object is the recorded derivation (gap note KG2).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
